verdict.rationale: Supabase documents a migration path for moving from another database service, with guides for many sources including Heroku, Amazon RDS, generic Postgres, Vercel Postgres, Neon and Firestore. Nothing in the evidence shows a minimal- or zero-downtime approach, so the downtime half of the story is unsupported. Missing for 10: evidence of a low-downtime import method (e.g. logical replication or continuous sync and cutover), details of the import steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration of production migrations.
